venira.avoid_when: you need tags/remote refs only (git branch --all) or a remote CI’s log (ci_logs).
venira.output_kind: mode=log: commits[] {sha, short_sha, author, email, authored_at, committer, subject, body}, count. mode=blame: entries[] {line, commit, author, authored_at, summary}, lines.
venira.speed_profile: bounded by limit; blame mode scales with file size and max_lines.
venira.use_when: you need recent commits or who last touched lines (blame).

description:
Local commit log, or per-line blame when blame=true with path. Filters: ref, author, grep, paths.
Use when: you need recent commits or who last touched lines (blame).
Avoid when: you need tags/remote refs only (git branch --all) or a remote CI’s log (ci_logs).
Output: mode=log: commits[] {sha, short_sha, author, email, authored_at, committer, subject, body}, count. mode=blame: entries[] {line, commit, author, authored_at, summary}, lines.

author.description: Filter commits by author name or email.

blame.description: true switches to blame mode for path (optionally ref).

path.description: Required when blame=true: the file to blame.

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to limit the log.

ref.description: Optional ref (branch, tag or commit sha). Default: HEAD.

name: git_log
title: Git log
